title: Engineering Development Engine upstream-source registry
description: Canonical, reference-only registry of the upstream repositories for every project-owned integration and specialist tool. It records WHERE an upstream lives and HOW FAR it has been verified; it must never assert installation state, a guessed version/commit, or a license that has not been verified. null = UNKNOWN (populate only after inspecting the repository). Tool detection/installation metadata stays in config/tool-manifest.json; entry ids here match the corresponding tool-manifest ids.

source.description: One upstream source. Field names are stable; do not assert unverified facts.

id.description: Stable machine identifier, lowercase kebab-case; matches the tool-manifest id where one exists.

repository_url.description: Canonical upstream source repository URL (https only).

documentation_url.description: Official documentation URL, or null when UNKNOWN (never guessed).

license_status.description: Whether the upstream license has been verified. UNKNOWN forbids a 'license' value.

version_status.description: Whether a specific upstream version/commit has been verified. UNKNOWN forbids 'version'/'commit' values.

integration_status.description: Maturity of this project's integration with the upstream source.

version.description: Pinned upstream version when verified, otherwise null.

commit.description: Pinned upstream commit when verified, otherwise null.

license.description: Verified upstream license identifier, otherwise null.

notes.description: Provenance/justification for the recorded statuses, or other caveats.
